cases.name: No unsolicited frames or reads; synthetic clicks cannot open the probe
Exactly two same-origin native documents, independent React tab handlers, same synthetic HttpOnly session
Both frames accept original input without switching the other frame; native timers and scroll remain independent
Export contains diagnostic flags, no cookie/form values, and no claim of live acceptance
Repeated trusted starts never duplicate instances; close destroys child contexts and restores the original UI
Reopen creates exactly two fresh contexts and close during initialization does not leave background frames
Preflight stops on xfo-deny without changing the parent or creating frames
Preflight stops on challenge without changing the parent or creating frames
Actual parent CSP frame-src is enforced by Chromium even when the preflight GET differs
Child frame-ancestors refusal never counts as success; no header removal or alternate preview
